attempts.summary: Provisioned an LVM logical volume (vg_data/lv_data) on node1, backed by a loop device over a sparse file (node1 has no spare block device), mounted at /srv/data via an Ansible playbook run from node2 (the pre-configured control node). Grew the LV from 1000M to ~2.15G (2.1G filesystem) while it stayed mounted, with test data verified byte-identical via sha256sum before/after growth and before/after node1's restart. Added a systemd unit to reattach the loop device and activate the VG on boot. Restarted node2 then node1 one at a time; boot_id changed on both, and /srv/data remained mounted at >2GB with intact data after node1's reboot.
